task.question: At the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix, how many years had Esteban Ocon been in Formula 1 since his debut?
task.evidence: At this weekend’s Belgian Grand Prix, Esteban Ocon will celebrate 10 years since his F1 debut.
task.page: Esteban Ocon reflects on 10 years in F1

answer:
Esteban Ocon made his Formula 1 debut at the 2016 Belgian Grand Prix. By the time of the 2026 Belgian Grand Prix, he had been in Formula 1 for 10 years.

FINAL: 10
